data.body:
Investigation correction: original premise (squash-merge SHA discard) does not apply to this project — git log shows merge commits ("Merge pull request #N"), not squash-merged.

Verified the current ancestry gate (plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/SKILL.md Step 2.5) already covers the realistic failure modes:
1. SHA in object store AND not remote tip → PASSED (squash-merge detection)
2. CLI_user tag + SHA is remote tip → WARNING demotion (proceeds with investigation)
3. SHA genuinely missing OR remote unavailable → FAILED (correct: investigation cannot proceed)

The 'FAILED — Investigation skipped' comments on older tickets (e.g. 0584-b545's 2026-05-12 comment) are relics of an earlier gate revision before the demotion paths were added. Running /dso:fix-bug today on those tickets hits the CLI_user demotion and proceeds without manual bypass — verified during the 2026-05-16/17 batch (all 8 user-named tickets were investigatable; bypass was offered out of caution but the current gate would have demoted via CLI_user).

No code change required — closing as 'fix-not-needed (premise refined)'.
